claims.population: With an estimated population of 153,000 (2009), Dutse is currently the largest city in Jigawa State.
claims.name: Dutse (Dutsi, in earlier notes) got its name from the rocky topography peculiar to the area. Dutse and its environs are well known for Date Trees (Dabino) of different varieties.
claims.emirate: The article describes Dutse as the capital city of Jigawa State and also the capital of Dutse Emirate.
claims.institutions: In addition to the Federal University Dutse, there is also a Research Institute for Date Palm (Sub-Station) and state polytechnic in Dutse.
claims.climate: The climate is a tropical savanna climate (Koppen: Aw).
